New scripts/check_core_only.py: builds the 8 core wheels (contracts, plugin-sdk, kernel, server, adapter-shacl, adapter-postgres, adapter-agent-pydantic, adapter-secretstore-local) into a temporary directory, never dist/; writes a throwaway hatchling project for core-test-pack (plugin id core-test-pack, one read capability corenotes.note.read.v1 bound as core-notes.read, a read-only executor, a scripted driver factory and the task preset core-note; it imports only e_agent.contracts and e_agent.sdk) and builds it with uv build; installs all 9 into one fresh uv venv outside the repository with --refresh-package for each first-party name; asserts, from the venv with python -I, that the installed distribution list is non-empty and holds none of the 4 ERP distributions, that none of e_agent.erp, e_agent.adapters.odoo and e_agent.plugins.erp is importable, and that the installed e-agent-server requires no ERP distribution; then starts `python -m e_agent.server.cli --profile

serve` on a free loopback port from a neutral directory and requires /health/ready to answer status ready with plugins == ['core-test-pack'], failing at once if the process exits; it prints counts and the elapsed time. Before the packaging change it failed as planned (3.4 s): uv could not resolve e-agent-server, naming e-agent-adapter-odoo rather than e-agent-domain-erp (same cause). After: about 10 s warm and 12 s with an empty uv cache, so harness/context.toml gains the set core = [check_core_only.py] and the same command joins full as its last step, and .github/workflows/ci.yml runs it in the wheels job after check_wheels.py. New tests/conformance/test_core_only.py (11 cases, about 1 s, imports the script by file path): the core list equals every dists/* project minus the named ERP set and fails on no dists, on an unclassified new dist and on a named ERP dist that does not exist; no core distribution's dependencies or extras name an ERP distribution; the pack project's entry point equals its manifest factory and versions agree; the profile validates as Profile with task_kind equal to the pack's preset; the pack composes through build_runtime in a subprocess from the same files and is the only admitted plugin; the forbidden-distribution check flags each ERP name and raises on an empty list.
